name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold opposite sides of the plate in front of your thighs.
Brace your core, keep your shoulders pulled back, and maintain a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the weight plate smoothly straight up in front of you until your arms reach roughly shoulder height.
Lower the plate slowly back down in front of your thighs without letting it swing.
tips: Avoid leaning your torso backward or shrugging your shoulders up as the plate rises.
Control the descent to keep constant tension across your front delts.
